column2: Retain Solomon's strengthening over his kingdom, the Lord's presence and his great exaltation. The second action's agent is God rather than Solomon's own military force.
Retain all Israel addressed through the named commanders, judges and rulers, including ancestral rulers. The appositional list is not reduced to army officers alone.
Retain Solomon and the whole assembly going to Gabaon's high place, where Moses' wilderness Tent of Testimony stood. The tent and ark locations are not prematurely merged.
Retain the contrasting ark location: David brought it from Kariathiarim and prepared its tent in Jerusalem. No additional city or transport detail is imported.

Retain the bronze altar, Beseleel's Ouriou/Or genealogy, its position before the Lord's tent and seeking it out. The selected neuter pronoun refers to the altar; it is not silently rendered sought the Lord.
Retain the altar before the Lord, the one in the tent and the thousandfold burnt offering. Do not turn the singular offering expression into a newly counted animal list.
column3: Thousandfold and the relation of in the tent to the preceding altar description remain lexical and spatial questions.

column2: Retain God's appearance that night and Ask what I should give you. No dream is explicitly named here, and no dream setting is imported from Kings.
Retain mercy to David and making Solomon king in his place. Thou/didst belong to Solomon's direct address to God, not narrative speech to a human king.
Retain Thy name confirmed upon David and the dust-of-earth comparison for the people. Do not substitute Thy promise for the selected name noun.
column3: The unusual name-confirmation expression remains a source-specific theological and syntactic question, not an apparatus-resolved reading.

column2: Retain wisdom and understanding, going out before the people and coming in, and the question who can judge God's great people. Thine preserves divine address, while the movement images remain rather than becoming a generic leadership paraphrase.

Retain wealth of possessions, glory, opponents' life and many days as unrequested, against requested wisdom and understanding for judgment. The inherited did ask gives contrastive emphasis rather than an archaic second-person ending.
Retain present giving of wisdom and understanding and future wealth, possessions and glory. The comparison with earlier and later kings remains without adding a restriction to Israel's kings.
Retain return from the bama in Gabaon to Jerusalem and reigning over Israel. Bama is the selected borrowed form, distinct from the high-place adjective in verse 3.
column3: The inherited untranslated bama requires a consistent policy with its treatment in 1 Chronicles; its retention is not editorial approval.

column2: Retain 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, the chariot-city placement and the people with the king in Jerusalem. Do not change people to an inferred subset of vehicles or horsemen.
Retain both gold and silver like stones and cedars in Judea like abundant plain sycamores. Judea is explicit in the selected clause and is not removed to match a parallel.
Retain Egypt, the king's merchants' price and buying to trade. Do not insert a Kue location or a linen trade to resolve the fragmentary price statement.
column3: The price clause's syntax and its link to the following import/export verbs remain unresolved.

column2: Retain one chariot for 600 in silver and a horse for 150, and trade through their hands for Chettite and Syrian kings. Monetary units are not supplied as shekels when unexpressed in this selected clause.
column3: The merchants' going up/exporting viewpoint and the antecedent of their hands remain open.

column2: Retain Solomon's resolve for both the Lord's name-house and his kingdom's house. The building decision remains at the end of selected chapter 1, not renumbered as chapter 2:1.
Retain 70,000 burden bearers, 80,000 mountain quarrymen and 3,600 overseers. No alternative 3,300 figure is imported from Kings.
Retain the message to Chiram of Tyre, his prior dealings with David and cedar for David's residence. The sentence intentionally continues into Solomon's own building announcement.

Retain I his son, consecration to God, incense, continual presentation and burnt offerings morning/evening and on the three festival categories. Presentation has no newly added bread noun; obligation supplies the enduring Israel requirement.
Retain the house's greatness grounded in God's greatness above all gods. The comparative does not become an added denial that other gods are being discussed.
Retain heaven and singular heaven of heaven unable to bear His glory, and the speaker's inability except for incense service. His glory is the selected object, not simply Him.

Retain a wise knowledgeable craftsman, all four metals and three colors, engraving skill and the prepared craftsmen in Judah and Jerusalem. Hyacinth blue is an inherited color interpretation, not a newly specified dye source.
Retain cedar, juniper and pine from Lebanon, the slaves' skill and your servants with my servants. Do not reverse the possessives to match another version.
column3: The timber species and the contextual distinction between douloi and paides remain lexical questions.

column2: Retain going to prepare abundant timber and the great and glorious house as rationale. The subjects continue the joined servants from the preceding unit.

Retain food grain as gifts to the workers, 20,000 kors each of grain and barley and 20,000 measures each of wine and oil. Do not invent bath equivalents or silently reorder the gifts into a different payment schedule.
Retain Chiram's written reply and the Lord's love for His people as reason for Solomon's kingship. God is the appointing subject, not Chiram.
Retain blessing of Israel's creator God, David's wise and knowledgeable son and the two houses. This is third-person praise of God, so ordinary is remains rather than Thou art.

Retain Chiram, my father as the sent skilled man, with his description continuing into verse 13. The selected father expression is not replaced with a professional title or a reconstructed Huram-abi name.
column3: Whether my father is kinship, honorific or a borrowed title remains unresolved; the reading does not establish the craftsman as the king's biological father.

column2: Retain his mother from Dan's daughters, Tyrian father, all material and textile skills, repeated engraving and design language, and cooperation with the two groups of craftsmen. Do not substitute a Naphtalite maternal identification from Kings.
column3: The parenthetical family description and its return to the long craftsman construction deserve punctuation review.

column2: Retain the grain, barley, oil and wine requested from my lord to his servants. The indirect third-person reference is not silently rewritten as the king's own servants or a fresh direct quotation.
column3: The possessive his servants refers contextually within the diplomatic exchange; exact ownership is not made explicit by the Greek pronoun alone.

column2: Retain all needed timber, rafts to Joppa's sea and Solomon's onward transport to Jerusalem. No route beyond the stated sea landing and destination is added.
Retain all resident foreign men, numbering after David's census and 153,600 total. The selected resident-foreigner term does not require a later religious-convert sense.

Retain 70,000 burden bearers, 80,000 quarrymen and 3,600 taskmasters, together equaling the stated total. The repeated division confirms the chapter's initial figures without changing the roles into military units.
